meta.title: AI Career Assistant
meta.description: See how your CV matches a job posting, with the evidence behind every judgement.

notFound.title: This page does not exist yet
notFound.body: The link may be wrong, or this part of the app has not been built yet.

result.sampleNotice: Sample analysis with a fictional CV and job posting.
result.requirementsEmpty: No requirements could be extracted from this job posting. Check that the full posting text was provided, then run the analysis again.
result.sheetEmpty: No evidence statements could be extracted from this CV.
result.fixesEmpty: No changes are suggested for this posting.
result.breakdownCaption: What the score is made of
result.breakdownNote: Wide pieces are must-haves; they count twice in the score.

questions.title: Interview questions
questions.intro: Questions an interviewer is likely to ask, based on this posting and the gaps above.
questions.error: The questions could not be generated. The AI service may be busy; try again in a minute.
questions.empty: No questions were returned for this posting.

progress.title: Comparing your CV with this posting
progress.body: Requirements are extracted from the posting, matched against your CV and checked for evidence. This usually takes a minute or two, longer when the free AI service is busy. The page updates on its own.

failed.title: This analysis could not be completed
failed.body: The AI service did not answer in time or returned an invalid result. Your CV and the posting are saved, so you can run the analysis again.

reasons.ai_quota_exhausted: The free AI quota is used up for now. It renews daily, so try again later; your CV and the posting are saved.
reasons.no_requirements_extracted: No requirements could be found in the job posting. Check that the full posting text was pasted, then start a new analysis.
reasons.no_evidence_extracted: No usable statements could be read from the CV. Check the CV text, then start a new analysis.

errorPage.title: This page could not be loaded
errorPage.body: The service may be unreachable for a moment. Nothing you saved is lost.

auth.samplePrompt: Want to see a result first?

errors.invalidCredentials: This email and password do not match an account. Check them and try again.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead, or use another email.
errors.passwordTooLong: This password is too long. Choose a shorter one.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many failed attempts for this email. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
errors.invalidInput: Check the fields: a valid email address and a password of at least 8 characters.
errors.unavailable: The service is not reachable right now. Try again in a minute.

empty.title: No analyses yet
empty.body: Add your CV and a job posting to see which requirements your CV supports and what to change before you apply.
empty.tryPrompt: Want to see it work first?
empty.tryLink: Try it with the sample CV and posting
empty.samplePrompt: Prefer to read a finished one?

newAnalysis.title: New analysis
newAnalysis.intro: Pick a CV, paste the job posting and start. An analysis usually takes a minute or two.
newAnalysis.fillSample: Fill with the sample CV and posting
newAnalysis.sampleFilled: Filled with a fictional sample CV and job posting. Start the analysis to see a live result.
newAnalysis.overLimit: Only the first {max} characters are analyzed.

resume.title: CV
resume.nameHint: Only you see this name, for example “CV, October 2026”.
resume.sourceLegend: How do you want to add it?
resume.textPlaceholder: Paste the full text of your CV…
resume.dropPrompt: Drop a PDF or Word file here, or
resume.fileHint: PDF or Word (.docx) up to 5 MB. A PDF needs selectable text (not a scan).

deleteConsequence.one: The analysis made with this CV is deleted too.
deleteConsequence.other: The {count} analyses made with this CV are deleted too.

resume.deleteFailed: The CV could not be deleted. Try again.

posting.title: Job posting
posting.textPlaceholder: Paste the full job posting, including the requirements…

newAnalysis.submitNote: You can leave this page while it runs; the result is saved under Analyses.

link.label: Link to the posting
link.hint: LinkedIn jobs and posts, Kariyer.net, Youthall and most job pages. If a site does not open, paste the text below.
link.filled: Filled from {site}. Check the job title and the text before you start.
link.filledNoTitle: Filled from {site}. The page has no job title: add it and check the text.

errors.missing: Paste the link to the posting first.
errors.invalid: This does not look like a web address. Copy the link from the address bar of your browser.
errors.notAllowed: This address cannot be read. Use the public link to the posting.
errors.blocked: This page could not be read: {site} does not allow it. Copy the posting text and paste it below.
errors.notFound: This page no longer exists; the posting may have been taken down.
errors.unreachable: Right now {site} is not answering. Try again in a moment or paste the text below.
errors.noPosting: We found no posting text on this page. Copy the posting text and paste it below.
errors.tooMany: Many links were read in the last hour. Try again later or paste the text below.
errors.unavailable: The link cannot be read right now. Paste the posting text below instead.

errors.resumeTextMissing: Paste the text of your CV.
errors.jobTextMissing: Paste the text of the job posting.
errors.tooShort: Add more text: at least 50 characters are needed for an analysis.
errors.fileMissing: Choose a PDF or Word file.
errors.fileType: Only PDF and Word (.docx) files can be uploaded. Save an older .doc file as .docx.
errors.fileTooLarge: This file is larger than 5 MB.
errors.pdfInvalid: This PDF could not be read. Try another file, or paste the text instead.
errors.pdfNoText: This PDF has no selectable text (it may be a scan). Paste the text instead.
errors.docxInvalid: This Word file could not be read. Try another file, or paste the text instead.
errors.docxNoText: This Word file has no text. Paste the text instead.
errors.pdfEncrypted: This PDF is password-protected. Remove the password or paste the text instead.
errors.unavailable: The service is not reachable right now. Your text is still here; try again in a minute.
errors.rateLimited: You have reached the limit of 20 analyses a day. Your text is still here; try again later.
errors.generic: The analysis could not be started. Your text is still here; try again.
